patch_title: PostProcessing v2 – correlated Monte Carlo weather with counterfactual replay and statistical corrections
train_and_test_split: Original PostProcessing month-stratified disjoint historical scenario protocol retained
weather_generation: Gaussian correlated AR(1)+day latent errors; mean-one lognormal DNI/DHI/wind; additive temperature and albedo; bound-projected GHI>=DHI and albedo; original irradiance closure residual preserved unless projected
statistical_claim: Sensitivity distribution is hypothetical, not NSRDB error calibrated
model_based_ensemble_changes: None. Existing one-step MBPO learning preserved; stochastic physical transitions enter real replay and its existing ensemble fit.
paired_evaluation: Identical scenario/realization ID, full weather SHA, UTC grid and initial pose
source_anchor_verification: GitHub read-only blob hashes and unique anchors verified for eight modified PostProcessing source files, including model validation
full_nsrdb_pvlib_runtime_verification: NOT RUN: no user seven-year NSRDB CSVs and no pvlib or gym in this environment
v1_upgrade_supported: Exact V1 package new modules only; changes are guarded by original V1 SHA-1
critical_fixes: Model validation counterfactual replay uses same fixed weather realization
Model validation accepts matching MC uncertainty config
Solar slew baseline matches current-time periodic-evaluation convention
Finite draw Monte Carlo variance and conditional MC SE reported separately
Power profiles output for every historical day
GHI>=DHI projection diagnostics and strict duplicate-albedo validation
Checkpoint scenario protocol must match requested split
v1_checkpoints: Do not reuse previous Monte Carlo v1 checkpoints after v2 weather QA/physical fingerprint changes; retrain both policies
